arStrings.szText:
{c_important}Shadow Imbuement{/c} deals {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"*100|%x|]{/c} increased damage per Skill Rank of the Imbued Skill. 
Every {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"]{/c} seconds, when your Imbued Skill hits an enemy you trigger a large explosion that deals {c_random}[(Owner.Weapon_Damage_Min_Total + Owner.Weapon_Damage_Delta_Total) * Affix_Value_1]{/c} Shadow damage and applies {c_important}Shadow Imbuement{/c} to each enemy it hits.

{c_important}Shadow Imbuement{/c} deals increased damage per Skill Rank of the Imbued Skill and the Imbued Skill explodes every {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"]{/c} seconds spreading {c_important}Shadow Imbuement{/c}.
